name: Mojarad Screenshot Mockup Carousel
author: Alireza Mojarad

sections.description:
Mojarad Screenshot Mockup Carousel is a lightweight WordPress plugin designed for presenting long website screenshots inside animated desktop and mobile device mockups.

The plugin automatically creates smooth scrolling animations, synchronized slide transitions, responsive layouts, and clean showcase sections suitable for portfolios, agencies, freelancers, UI/UX presentations, and modern case-study pages.

Desktop and mobile screenshots remain synchronized while switching slides, creating a premium and visually engaging presentation style.

Built with a lightweight frontend architecture and without bloated dependencies.

Features

  • Animated desktop and mobile mockups
  • Smooth auto-scrolling screenshots
  • Synchronized slide transitions
  • Responsive layouts
  • Lightweight frontend rendering
  • Shortcode support
  • Global animation settings
  • Hover pause support
  • Automatic image scaling
  • Drag & drop slide sorting
  • Theme-independent architecture
  • Built-in fallback screenshots

Recommended Screenshot Workflow

For desktop screenshots, it is highly recommended to use the GoFullPage Chrome extension to capture full-page screenshots.

Long screenshots create significantly smoother scrolling animations inside the mockups.

For mobile screenshots, full-page continuous screenshots are recommended as well. Many Samsung devices support long screenshot capture natively. Other devices may require browser-based tools or third-party applications depending on the operating system.

Perfect For

  • Freelancers
  • Agencies
  • Portfolio websites
  • Product showcases
  • Case studies
  • UI/UX presentations
  • Creative studios
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Create a new Showcase item from the admin dashboard.
  4. Upload desktop and mobile screenshots for each slide.
  5. Use the generated shortcode anywhere on your website.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin support responsive layouts?

Yes. The showcase layout is fully responsive and automatically adapts to different screen sizes.

Can I use only desktop screenshots?

Yes. If a mobile screenshot is not provided, the plugin automatically displays a built-in fallback image.

Does the plugin require Elementor?

No. The plugin is completely standalone and works with any WordPress theme.

Can I control autoplay and animation speed?

Yes. Global animation settings are available from the plugin settings panel.
